description: Working on the Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer challenge, combining technology, interactive experiences, and space science to create an engaging learning experience for young astronauts.
summary:
ASTRAX: OUTPOST ZERO is an interactive 3D Mars outpost simulation that introduces users to the challenges of establishing a sustainable human presence on Mars. Players explore a procedurally generated Martian environment, navigate the outpost, and construct infrastructure while learning about the systems needed to support a crew beyond Earth.

By combining immersive 3D exploration, construction, and resource-management concepts, ASTRAX transforms complex space-engineering challenges into an accessible hands-on experience. It encourages users to think about how essential systems such as power, life support, food production, and radiation protection contribute to the sustainability of a Mars settlement.

Developed with React, TypeScript, Three.js, and React Three Fiber, ASTRAX aims to spark scientific curiosity, develop problem-solving skills, and inspire the next generation of space explorers.
details:
Project Overview

ASTRAX: OUTPOST ZERO is an interactive 3D Mars outpost simulation developed to introduce users to the scientific, engineering, and operational challenges of establishing a sustainable human presence on Mars.

How It Works

Users enter an immersive Martian environment where they can explore the outpost, navigate its surroundings, and construct infrastructure. The experience combines environmental exploration with construction and resource-management concepts, illustrating the importance of essential systems such as power generation, life support, food production, and radiation protection.

Through interaction with the simulated environment, users gain an understanding of how different infrastructure decisions can affect the sustainability of a Mars settlement.

Benefits and Intended Impact

ASTRAX makes complex space-exploration concepts more accessible through an interactive learning experience. It encourages scientific curiosity, critical thinking, problem-solving, and an understanding of the multidisciplinary challenges involved in supporting human life beyond Earth.

Our goal is to inspire young learners to explore space science, engineering, and technology.

Technologies Used

The project was developed using TypeScript, JavaScript, React, Vite, Three.js, and React Three Fiber. These technologies support the browser-based interface and real-time 3D environment. The Martian terrain and environment are procedurally generated within the application.

Creativity and Design Considerations

ASTRAX combines cinematic storytelling, immersive environmental exploration, interactive construction, and simulation concepts into one experience. Instead of presenting space science through static information, it allows users to engage with a simulated Mars outpost.

During development, our team considered visual immersion, usability, accessibility, performance, scientific relevance, and the importance of making complex engineering concepts understandable to a broad audience.
